description: Opus CC unit B18: Copycat calling Spit Up (its onAfterMove, formerly refused for a called move). Setup turn: Hypno and Jolteon each Stockpile once (+1 Def and SpD). The turn: Jolteon's Spit Up at Blissey is blocked by Protect and its own AfterMove ends its stockpile (it is still battle.lastMove); Hypno's Copycat calls Spit Up (battle.lastMove) at a random foe with its own layer, and runMove's AfterMove, which sees the called move, ends Hypno's stockpile: its onEnd takes back Hypno's two raises.
